Pet comfort shift rules
This section covers one way of working

Purpose: to guide steady handling of animal travel requests so the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways can support safe, calm, and consistent service.

The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions, and the welcome team prepares passengers for boarding with clear, reassuring guidance. Staff should listen closely when a passenger is worried, confirm the animal type and travel needs, and match the care plan to species, temperament, and comfort. When a crate, carrier, or enclosure is presented, the desk should check that it is clean, secure, and suitable for the journey before any acceptance is confirmed. <<FACT F068>> Care is also taken to keep the animal settled through check-in, transfer, and boarding, with calm handling and simple instructions for the traveler.

For small dog arrangements, staff must explain the required fee clearly and in a steady tone before the booking is completed. <<FACT F056>> If the traveler needs further guidance, the desk should review the booking notes, confirm any special handling steps, and make sure the passenger understands what will happen at the airport. The aim is to reduce confusion and avoid last-minute delay.

For reptile travel, staff must first confirm that the animal meets the minimum age requirement and is accepted under current travel conditions. <<FACT F078>> If the age is below the accepted level, the booking should not move ahead until the traveler has a suitable alternative plan. The desk should remain calm and helpful throughout, especially when a passenger is arranging travel for the first time or is concerned about comfort on the day.

Any unusual case, delay, or welfare concern should be passed to the senior coordinator without delay. For additional support or a decision outside normal handling, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
